summary: Frontend-only verification of FOXY Properties Enquiry Notes + Dashboard Calendar & Tasks + Agent scoping. All acceptance criteria pass: Dashboard shows calendar-tasks with widget-viewings/upcoming/overdue (+ -count children); empty states render correctly. task-add-btn opens task-form with all expected fields (task-description, task-related w/ 'No link / type your own' option, task-related-text, task-due-date, task-assignee, task-priority, task-save, task-cancel). Creating a past-due task immediately appears in Overdue widget in red with 'N days overdue' (task-due-{id}) and tasks-overdue-badge='1' appears next to nav-dashboard with NO page reload. Creating a +3 days task appears in Upcoming sorted by date. Clicking task-complete-{id} optimistically removes task, decrements widget-overdue-count 1→0, and removes the tasks-overdue-badge. Enquiry notes: enquiry-notes-btn-{id} opens enquiry-notes-{id} panel with note-kind/note-body/note-save; saving an EMAIL note increments enquiry-notes-count-{id} from (1)→(2) and persists after full page reload. Agent login (Test Agent): sidebar reduced to nav-my-tasks + nav-enquiries only (no nav-dashboard/appointments/clients/users/leads/offers); redirected to /backoffice/enquiries on login; /backoffice/tasks shows only tasks assigned to Test Agent (sees 'Call back about offer' but NOT admin-created unassigned 'TEST upcoming task beta'); can complete own task. Regression: existing enquiries status change and badge still functional. Properties/Clients optgroups did not render — EXPECTED because properties and clients tables are empty in current DB (0 rows each) per task description.

issues: Pre-existing issue carried from iteration_27: data-testid=cookie-banner is fixed inset-0 full-screen overlay blocking interactions until dismissed. Not blocking this feature but worth revisiting.

critical_code_review_comments: src/components/backoffice/CalendarTasks.tsx task-complete uses <button> with 4x4 rounded border styling — purely visual, no visible checked state after click (optimistic remove hides it). Fine functionally; may want aria-pressed for a11y and clearer affordance.
src/app/api/backoffice/tasks/route.ts: GET returns 503 with empty arrays on error — swallows error details. Fine for prod but consider logging server-side (likely already is via console).

AddTaskForm shows 'Clients' and 'Properties' optgroups via tasks/options; when BOTH tables empty, only 'No link / type your own' option renders — acceptable but a tiny caption like 'No clients or properties yet' inside the select could help UX.

Today's Viewings count shows 0 while top KPI 'Today's appointments' shows 1 — this is because the seed viewing's starts_at (2026-10-12 22:00 UTC = 23:00 BST on Oct 12) is YESTERDAY in London once the clock crosses midnight BST, while the top KPI likely uses a different window. Not a bug per se but the two numbers can look inconsistent during edge-of-day testing. Consider aligning both to the same TZ-aware 'today' definition.
